title: A morning like a Shanghainese

discovery.summary: Learn breakfast names, use a Chinese ordering card and choose whether to try something.

costNature: Pay the vendor for any purchase. No verified shop, price or opening time is supplied.
conditions: Use only areas currently open to the public.
Participation is optional; no interaction with residents is required.
risks: Current access and opening conditions may differ from this saved snapshot.
Respect privacy, signs and staff instructions.
steps: Learn the four breakfast food names in the story.
Choose an open public-facing shop with clearly displayed prices; no vendor is endorsed here.
Ask the price and ingredients; confirm dietary needs and the total before paying.
Record one food word or observation. Buying food is optional.
alternative: If prices or ingredients are unclear, skip the purchase and observe a publicly displayed menu instead.

observations.title: One unfamiliar food
observations.prompt: Find one food name on a public menu that is new to you. Ask about ingredients and the total price before making a decision.

observations.title: A small, optional choice
observations.prompt: If the ingredients and price are clear and suitable for you, you may order. Otherwise, learning a food word is a complete observation; a purchase is optional.

shortPromise: Learn a few local food names and decide whether to try something at a shop you choose.
